review:
A cat explorer in Aztec ruins on a 6x8 cluster grid. Clusters of five or more pay, the reels refill, and wins reveal cell multipliers underneath.

Paw scatters start free spins and then turn into even more volatile symbols, while bonus symbols can trigger surprise events. You can also play in Wild Spin mode or choose from four buy options. 10,000x max and a 97% RTP; BGaming doesn't publish a volatility rating, but it's built on the same idea as Aztec Clusters with more ways to customise it.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
